dt: Deadlines Apr 20 and Oct 20 each year; the Oct 20, 2026 round has closed, next deadline Apr 20, 2027
e: For PhD students at any university (Garching prefers ESO member states; Chile gives recruitment preference to member-state nationals). 6 months–2 years at ESO, mostly optical/IR/ALMA, so a weak fit for pulsar timing.
